0.0: After the equipping character has been off-field for at least 5s, they gain the Revitalizing Spark effect: ATK is increased by <cryo>20%</cryo>. Switching them on-field while in combat will deal AoE DMG to nearby opponents equal to <cryo>280%</cryo> of the equipping character's ATK, and this can be triggered once every 14s. The Revitalizing Spark effect will be canceled after the character has been on-field for more than 10s.
